'''Grzegorz Jacek Wrochna''' (born March 13, 1962, in [[Radom|Radom, Poland]]) is a Polish physicist who served as the President of the [[Polish Space Agency]] from 2021 to 2025. Before his nomination to this position, he was the director of the [[:pl:Narodowe Centrum Badań Jądrowych|National Center for Nuclear Research]] from 2011 to 2015, and an under-secretary in the [[Ministry of Science and Higher Education (Poland)|Ministry of Science and Higher Education]] from 2019 to 2021.

== Early life ==
Wrochna was born on March 13, 1962, in Radom. After graduating from the VI Jan Kochanowski High School, Wrochna studied [[physics]] at the [[University of Warsaw]]. In 1986, he began working as an assistant researcher in the Institute of Experimental Physics at the University of Warsaw.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. Grzegorz Wrochna becomes the president of the Polish Space Agency {{!}} Polish Science|url=https://polishscience.pl/en/prof-grzegorz-wrochna-becomes-the-president-of-the-polish-space-agency/|access-date=2021-12-19|website=polishscience.pl}}</ref> In 1991 Wrochna defended his doctoral dissertation, which was written under the supervision of Polish experimental physicist [[Andrzej Kajetan Wróblewski]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Wrochna, Grzegorz - CzyCzy|url=http://czyczy.pl/source/wrochna-grzegorz/|access-date=2021-12-19|website=czyczy.pl}}</ref>

== Career ==
In the years 1991 to 1998 Wrochna worked at [[CERN]] in [[Geneva|Geneva, Switzerland]]. He partook in a team searching for the [[Higgs boson|Higgs Boson]], which was ultimately discovered in 2012. In 1998 he received his [[habilitation]] at the University of Warsaw. From 1999 to 2006 was employed as a [[docent]] at the National Institute for Nuclear Research (IPJ) and he continued work on the [[Compact Muon Solenoid]] (CMS) detector.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-04-09|title=prof. dr hab. Grzegorz Wrochna {{!}} Narodowe Centrum Badań Jądrowych|url=http://ncbj.gov.pl/pl/prof-dr-hab-grzegorz-wrochna|access-date=2021-12-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170409021545/http://ncbj.gov.pl/pl/prof-dr-hab-grzegorz-wrochna |archive-date=2017-04-09 }}</ref> On October 30, 2006, he was designated as the new director of the IPJ.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Federation|first=International Astronautical|title=IAF : Grzegorz WROCHNA|url=https://www.iafastro.org/biographie/grzegorz-wrochna.html|access-date=2021-12-19|website=www.iafastro.org|language=en}}</ref> In 2009 Wrochna was appointed as a Professor of Physical Sciences and in October 2015 he oversaw the creation of the new facilities of the National Center for Nuclear Research in Świerk, Poland. On December 16, 2019, [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] nominated Professor Wrochna to serve as an under-secretary in the [[Ministry of Science and Higher Education (Poland)|Ministry of Science and Higher Education]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. dr hab. Grzegorz Wrochna podsekretarzem stanu w MNiSW - Ministerstwo Edukacji i Nauki - Portal Gov.pl|url=https://www.gov.pl/web/edukacja-i-nauka/prof-dr-hab-grzegorz-wrochna-podsekretarzem-stanu-w-mnisw|access-date=2021-12-19|website=Ministerstwo Edukacji i Nauki|language=pl-PL}}</ref> With the dissolution of the ministry on January 1, 2021, Wrochna left government service. On February 18, 2021, he was designated as the new President of the Polish Space Agency, succeeding [[Michał Szaniawski]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Michał Szaniawski nie jest już prezesem Polskiej Agencji Kosmicznej |url=https://space24.pl/polityka-kosmiczna/nieoficjalnie-michal-szaniawski-nie-jest-juz-prezesem-polskiej-agencji-kosmicznej |website=space24.pl |date=2 December 2020 |access-date=5 June 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Struktura organizacyjna - POLSA|url=https://polsa.gov.pl/o-nas/struktura-organizacyjna/|access-date=2021-12-19|language=pl-PL}}</ref> In October 2021 Wrochna signed the [[Artemis Accords]] with [[NASA deputy administrator|NASA Deputy Administrator]] [[Pamela Melroy]] at the [[International Astronautical Congress]] in [[Dubai]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Potter|first=Sean|date=2021-10-26|title=Poland Signs Artemis Accords at IAC|url=http://www.nasa.gov/feature/poland-signs-artemis-accords-at-iac|access-date=2021-12-19|website=NASA}}</ref>

Wrochna would be abruptly dismissed from his post as POLSA President on March 11, 2025, due to his mishandling of the [[Starlink]] 11-4 [[Falcon 9]] booster spinning out of control over Poland and disintegrating into several large chunks on February 19.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Webster |first1=Eve |title=SpaceX rocket debris crashes into Poland |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c62z3vxjplpo |website=[[BBC]] |access-date=5 December 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Dossett |first1=Julian |title=SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket debris creates dramatic fireball over Europe, crashes in Poland (video) |url=https://www.space.com/space-exploration/launches-spacecraft/spacex-falcon-9-rocket-debris-creates-dramatic-fireball-over-europe-crashes-in-poland |website=[[Space.com]] |access-date=5 December 2025}}</ref><ref name="Wrochna fired">{{cite web |title=Polish Space Agency President Sacked Over Falcon 9 Debris Controversy |url=https://europeanspaceflight.com/polish-space-agency-president-sacked-over-falcon-9-debris-controversy/ |website=European Spaceflight |access-date=5 December 2025}}</ref> The day after the crash POLSA had issued a statement that they “constantly monitor and analyzes threats in outer space originating from artificial objects, including rockets” and claimed to have adequately warned the government about the uncontrolled re-entry, however, the Ministry of Development and Technology disputed this alleging "irregularities that occurred in the process of reporting by the Polish Space Agency" with [[Krzysztof Paszyk]] urgently summoning Wrocha for an explanation.<ref name="Wrochna fired"/> Paszyk also claimed that POLSA's earlier statement that they adequately warned the government "did not reflect the assessment of the situation resulting from the reports sent by the Agency and could have misled the public."<ref name="Wrochna fired"/> On February 28 POLSA issued a formal apology, stating that they sent the report to the wrong email at the Ministry of National Defence.<ref name="Wrochna fired"/> Shortly after on March 2, POLSA's main servers where hacked in a [[cyberattack]] only being restored on March 5, just 6 days before Wrocha was dismissed.<ref name="Wrochna fired"/>

== Awards and honours ==
Wrochna was presented the SciVal Best Connectivity Award in November 2012 for effective collaboration with an international network of scientists. The award was presented by the ''Persyspektywy'' Educational Foundation and the publishing company [[Elsevier]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=ELSEVIER-PERSPEKTYWY Young Researcher Awards 2012|url=http://www.perspektywy.org/elsevier/|access-date=2021-12-19|website=www.perspektywy.org}}</ref> In 2015 Wrochna received the [[Order of Polonia Restituta|Order of Polonia Restitutia]] for his contributions to the Polish scientific community and academic engagement in the field of [[nuclear physics]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 10 czerwca 2015 r. o nadaniu orderów|url=http://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20150000840|access-date=2021-12-19|website=isap.sejm.gov.pl}}</ref> In 2018, he received the [[Ordre des Palmes académiques]], which is presented to academics for exceptional scientific contributions.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Francuskie odznaczenia dla polskich naukowców zajmujących się energią jądrową|url=https://naukawpolsce.pl/aktualnosci/news%2C29840%2Cfrancuskie-odznaczenia-dla-polskich-naukowcow-zajmujacych-sie-energia|access-date=2021-12-19|website=Nauka w Polsce|language=pl}}</ref> In November 2019, Wrochna received the ''[[:pl:Medal Stulecia Odzyskanej Niepodległości|Medal Stulecia Odzyskanej Niepodległości]]'' which was presented during [[National Independence Day (Poland)|Poland's Centennial Independence Day Anniversary]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-04-17|title=Medale stulecia dla profesorów Strupczewskiego i Wrochny|url=https://www.ncbj.gov.pl/aktualnosci/medale-stulecia-profesorow-strupczewskiego-wrochny|access-date=2021-12-19|website=Narodowe Centrum Badań Jądrowych}}</ref>
